name: Ruby on Rails 8 + Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus) + SQLite/PostgreSQL
note: Requires Ruby and Bundler. Uses SQLite, so no database server is needed. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Model and controller tests pass
eval_tasks.instruction: The Minitest suite covering Post model and PostsController must pass.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && bundle exec rails test

eval_tasks.title: Brakeman finds no high or medium warnings
eval_tasks.instruction: Static analysis of the Rails app must be clean at confidence level 2.

eval_tasks.title: Strict loading prevents N+1 queries
eval_tasks.instruction: Associations must be strict-loaded in test so an N+1 raises instead of silently degrading.
assertions: rails test exits 0 with strict_loading enabled
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rails test
